prs.title: [css-fonts-4] Correct the OpenType references in font-kerning
prs.author: JinDX
prs.body:
Name vpal for proportional vertical metrics, matching the vertical kerning algorithm. Link kern to the OpenType table referenced by the sentence.

Found while reviewing the [Chinese](https://htmlspecs.com/css/css-fonts-4/), [Japanese](https://jp.htmlspecs.com/css/css-fonts-4/), and [Korean](https://ko.htmlspecs.com/css/css-fonts-4/) translations.

prs.title: [css-gaps-1] Add segment endpoints around grid-lanes spanners #14648
prs.author: jav099
prs.body:
For grid-axis gaps in grid lanes, create end and start segment endpoints before and after spanning items, using their positions after self-alignment. Offset the endpoints by the stacking-axis gap size.

These endpoints do not create new gutters or gap junctions. Gutter placement and the rule-break algorithms are unchanged.

This change allows grid axis rules to extend to and past aligned spanners.

#14648.
